explication: This repository is the Temporal Swift SDK: it lets applications define workflows and activities, run them on workers, and use a client to communicate with a Temporal server. Its principal path is application-defined workflow/activity code, worker execution, and client-submitted workflow operations against the server. The README also documents macros, observability, and testing; the tree shows additional client, conversion, replay, and administration subsystems. Edges below rely on README statements and the sampled excerpts; unsampled subsystem connections are omitted where their callers are not evidenced.
